finding: Governed assets pass through router/operation/contracts/bindings/evidence/readback, while mutation of governance tables themselves can occur through direct SQL without an equivalent governed operation and evidence chain.
facts_to_preserve: lf_prod_enforcement_step_gate_v01 is the effective execution-step gate
required_evidence_keys are enforced from lf_operation_step_judge_bindings rather than merely from step contracts
judge pass_if/fail_if are compared with caller-provided assertions_checked/hard_fails_checked and therefore are attestation unless backed by deterministic server authority
a structural judge with empty pass_if/fail_if derives clean absent other binding/trigger failures
short_term_recommendations_for_transvers: Evaluate provenance guards for semantic judge columns including judge_sha/pass_if/fail_if/result_values
Evaluate equivalent mutation guards for operation step contracts and judge bindings
Require governed provenance state appropriate to mutation rather than existence-only provenance
Document the enforcement model before further semantic governance-table mutations
medium_term_decision: Decide whether governance-table mutation becomes an existing-core governed operation; do not create a new service/layer by default.
